description: This walk visits Castlehill Reservoir in Glen Devon in Perth and Kinross. You can park at the southern end of the reservoir and then enjoy a walk along the impressive dam. In this area there's also some woodlands and views of the River Devon as it enters the reservoir. You can continue your walking in the area on the Glendevon Walk which further explores the glen. Here you can enjoy more fine views of the surrounding Ochil Hills and countryside and explore Glen Sherup. Here you can visit the Glen Sherup Reservoir before a climb to the viewpoint at Ben Shee.
